canonicalRequirements.statement: Bind the GATE22 canonical mandate by its exact SHA-256; the mandate is ratification only and grants neither START nor BUILD.
Bind the GATE22-owned successor pin surface GATE22_SUCCESSOR_SCHEMA_PINS materializing PROMO-1 Option B; it is not a contract and is never counted in contractCount.
Coverage is exactly seven execution contracts C1..C7 in the mandate order; no eighth contract, no rename, no merge and no design-freeze identifier promoted into a contract.
GATE21 LAB_SCHEMA_PINS stays frozen at 27 keys, GATE21_BINDING_V1 and revisions R0001..R0005 stay unmodified, and research/directional-lab stays byte-identical.
Preserve GATE22 as NOT_STARTED and GATE21 as COMPLETE_CONFIRMED at state revision R0005; this cohort creates no ledger event, no state revision and no ACTIVE_GATE mutation.
The only authorized cohort is the precontract contract, its pointer and the primitive-generated consumption receipt; functional implementation stays unauthorized because START is not BUILD.

requiredOutputs.role: Pointer to the exact versioned contract

positiveTests.case: the candidate contract and pointer bytes validate against the canonical contract schema
the successor pin surface declares exactly one pin consumed only through consumesGate22SuccessorPins
the projected contract set declares exactly seven contracts identical to the mandate

negativeTests.case: START, BUILD, label, Observation, Outcome or lifecycle transition request under this candidate
instrumentIdentityV1 declared inside any consumesGate21Pins array
an eighth contract or a renamed contractId
any write to a GATE21 surface or to research/directional-lab

countertests.case: this candidate presented as an activated CURRENT_CONTRACT for GATE22
this candidate presented as a consumed Owner START authority
mandate bytes changed after this binding

reuseRules: Reuse the GATE21 precontract cohort format and the existing GEE precontract primitives without modification.
Reuse the audited GATE22_CANONICAL_MANDATE_R0 bytes as the sole design authority; the Design Freeze is closed and is not reopened.
Reuse the already materialized GATE22_SUCCESSOR_SCHEMA_PINS surface rather than re-deriving instrument identity.
invalidationRules: Any drift of a hash-pinned required input blocks this candidate.
Any loss of GATE21 COMPLETE_CONFIRMED at state revision R0005 blocks this candidate.
Any change to the GATE21 27-key LAB_SCHEMA_PINS vocabulary blocks this candidate.
Any divergence between the seven projected contracts and the mandate blocks this candidate.
closureConditions: This document is a NON_ACTIVATED CANDIDATE. It is not published at governance/gates/GATE22/contracts/, it is not pointed to by any CURRENT_CONTRACT and no authority has been consumed for it.
This candidate is not closure, not confirmation, not START and not BUILD.
A later separately authorized lifecycle may publish an identical contract at the canonical path only under its own Owner authority.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: No next-Gate authorization is created by this candidate.

checkpointPolicy.resume: GATE22 PRE-START closure package; H-1 restored, PROMO-1 Option B materialized, mandate bound by audited SHA
checkpointPolicy.reuse: GATE21 lifecycle patterns and GEE precontract primitives
checkpointPolicy.independentConfirmation: required separately before START is executed
